_meta.note: Chosen once at level 3+. Permanent. Reshapes your signature ability and combat profile.

fighter.name: Champion
fighter.description: A relentless bruiser who turns glancing blows into devastating ones.

fighter.name: Berserker
fighter.description: Throws caution aside — Power Attack lands far harder, and blood spilled is health regained.

rogue.name: Assassin
rogue.description: Strikes first and hardest — a Sneak Attack that can end fights outright.

rogue.name: Swashbuckler
rogue.description: A duelist who dances out of reach, bleeds foes for vigor, and pockets extra coin.

wizard.name: Evoker
wizard.description: Pours everything into the blast — a Fireball that incinerates almost anything.

wizard.name: Abjurer
wizard.description: Wraps a protective ward around the frail mage, trading a little burst for real durability.

cleric.name: Life Domain
cleric.description: Channels brighter light — a far stronger Heal and a sturdier frame.

cleric.name: War Domain
cleric.description: Trades some healing for the smite — real offense from a holy warrior.
